-2-  NC: 2026:KHC:6367  CRL.P No. 396 of 2024  HC-KAR  THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 OF CR.P.C., PRAYING TO QUASH THE F.I.R., COMPLIANT AND CHARGESHEET AND ANY CONSEQUENTIAL PROCEEDINGS THEREIN ARISING OUT OF FIR IN QUESTION, 467/2017 AND (S.C.NO.1033/2018)
REGISTERED AT PEENYA POLICE STATION FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S.376, 420, 354, 498(A), 323, 504, 506 R/W SEC.34 OF IPC AND SEC.4 OF DP ACT ON THE FILE OF THE HON'BLE LIII CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS COURT, BENGALURU AGAINST THE PETITIONER BY ALLOWING THIS PETITION.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner files a memo seeking withdrawal of the Criminal Petition.

The memo so filed reads as follows:
"The undersigned counsel for the petitioner hereby submits that counsel for the petitioner hereby most humbly request to withdraw the above matter as not pressed.
As the matter in the trial court is at the stage of 313 statement.
Hence this memo in the interest of justice."
In terms of memo, the Criminal Petition is disposed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
